description: This file defines a utility enum `GatewayRemoteConfig` with static methods to resolve and normalize configuration data related to network gateways, including URL handling, token processing, and transport type determination.

methods.name: resolveTransport
methods.description: Determines the remote transport type (.direct or .ssh) based on nested dictionary configuration.

methods.name: resolveUrlString
methods.description: Extracts and trims the URL string from nested configuration dictionary.

methods.name: resolveTokenValue
methods.description: Retrieves and classifies the token value from configuration, distinguishing between missing, non-string, and plaintext.

methods.name: resolveTokenString
methods.description: Returns the token string if available and valid; otherwise nil.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Converts the URL string from configuration into a URL object, normalizing it.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrlString
methods.description: Returns the absolute string representation of a normalized URL, or nil.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrl
methods.description: Trims and validates the URL string, returning a URL object if scheme and host are valid and meet specific criteria.

methods.name: defaultPort
methods.description: Provides default port numbers based on URL scheme if none is specified.
